steps.message:
Build a 9-slide, 16:9 analytical presentation titled "Auditing Model Substitution in LLM APIs: Why Software Tests Fail and Hardware Attestation Wins" for ML researchers, AI security practitioners, and cloud infrastructure engineers evaluating LLM API integrity.

The narrative arc begins by establishing the economic incentives behind covert model substitution in commercial LLM APIs, then systematically demonstrates through empirical evidence why software-based detection methods—statistical tests, log-probability fingerprinting, and benchmark comparisons—are fundamentally unreliable. The deck concludes by presenting Trusted Execution Environments as the provably secure, actionable alternative for verifiable inference.

For the "Quantization Benchmark Drop" slide, include a structured data table comparing original vs. FP8-quantized scores across MMLU, GSM8K, MATH, and GPQA Diamond for five model families, using values from the source brief. For the "Software-Only Auditing Methods" slide, present a comparison matrix summarizing the three failure modes (text-based statistical tests, log-probability methods, adversarial countermeasures) with columns for method type, weakness, and practical limitation. Reference figure_1.jpg for the temperature-scaling slide and figure_5.jpg for the log-probability nondeterminism slide where applicable.

Maintain an evidence-driven, technical tone throughout. Do not fabricate data not found in source_brief.md.


## Data Sources

1. **Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md`**  for all the subject-matter text, data tables, statistics, and figure references you may use in the presentation.
2. **Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json`**  for **structural requirements**: deck metadata (slide count, aspect ratio, audience, tone) and a per-slide outline (id, title, objective) that your presentation must follow.

## Output Requirements

Save the final PPT to `/app/output/final_deck.pptx`.

Only the correctly saved final file is needed — no additional explanation is required.

---

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or "wait for user confirmation" instructions, make a professional judgment and proceed.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies fields such as `deck.tone` or `deck.audience`, use them to guide template, color palette, and style choices; otherwise, use your professional judgment.
3. **Do not deploy or share** — no deployment, PDF export, share links, or other post-delivery steps are needed.
4. **Priority** — these rules take precedence over any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The workflow, quality standards, and technical specifications in SKILL.md remain in effect; only interactive waits are skipped.

arguments.command:
cat << 'EOF' > /app/tmp_generate_ppt.py
import collections.abc
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

def create_deck():
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

    title_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]
    bullet_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]
    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]
    
    def add_title(slide, text):
        title = slide.shapes.title
        title.text = text
        title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.name = "Arial"
        title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(36)
        title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
        title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x33, 0x66)

    # 1. Title Slide
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(title_layout)
    title = slide.shapes.title
    subtitle = slide.placeholders[1]
    title.text = "Auditing Model Substitution in LLM APIs\nWhy Software Tests Fail and Hardware Attestation Wins"
    title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(44)
    subtitle.text = "Are You Getting What You Pay For?\nBased on arXiv:2504.04715"

    # 2. The Model Substitution Problem
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(bullet_layout)
    add_title(slide, "The Model Substitution Problem: Economic Incentives Drive Covert Swaps")
    body = slide.shapes.placeholders[1]
    tf = body.text_frame
    tf.text = "Providers face economic incentives to substitute cheaper models to cut GPU costs."
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Four main types of substitution:"
    p.level = 0
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "1. Smaller Models (e.g., 8B instead of 70B)"
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "2. Quantized Variants (e.g., FP8/INT8 instead of FP16)"
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "3. Fine-tuned or Updated Versions"
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "4. Entirely Different Model Families"
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Formalized as Hypothesis Testing: Can an auditor distinguish P_spec(y|x) from P_actual(y|x)?"
    p.level = 0

    # 3. FP8 Quantization Preserves Most Accuracy
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
    txbox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(0.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(1))
    tf = txbox.text_frame
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "FP8 Quantization Preserves Most Accuracy — Making Substitution Hard to Detect"
    p.font.name = "Arial"
    p.font.size = Pt(32)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x33, 0x66)
    
    rows = 11
    cols = 5
    table = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(5)).table
    
    headers = ["Model", "MMLU", "GSM8K", "MATH", "GPQA Diamond"]
    for j, header in enumerate(headers):
        cell = table.cell(0, j)
        cell.text = header
        cell.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
        
    data = [
        ["Llama-3-8B-Instruct", "62.69 ± 0.18", "61.14 ± 3.47", "20.65 ± 3.43", "22.62 ± 0.22"],
        ["Llama-3-8B-Instruct-FP8", "62.43 ± 0.26", "60.90 ± 4.10", "14.91 ± 2.49", "20.14 ± 0.24"],
        ["Llama-3-70B-Instruct", "78.05 ± 0.08", "88.06 ± 1.44", "35.69 ± 1.33", "29.60 ± 0.51"],
        ["Llama-3-70B-Instruct-FP8", "77.88 ± 0.13", "87.35 ± 1.24", "35.75 ± 1.16", "33.12 ± 0.30"],
        ["Gemma-2-9b-it", "71.86 ± 0.08", "81.80 ± 1.35", "33.41 ± 0.28", "28.64 ± 2.97"],
        ["Gemma-2-9b-it-FP8", "71.92 ± 0.11", "79.41 ± 1.14", "32.53 ± 0.34", "27.81 ± 3.22"],
        ["Qwen2-72B-Instruct", "82.18 ± 0.08", "86.72 ± 1.00", "37.39 ± 1.41", "29.93 ± 2.71"],
        ["Qwen2-72B-Instruct-FP8", "81.98 ± 0.08", "86.82 ± 0.97", "37.67 ± 1.39", "31.08 ± 1.96"],
        ["Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3", "59.15 ± 0.10", "35.90 ± 4.54", "8.94 ± 1.24", "21.60 ± 0.17"],
        ["Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3-FP8", "58.77 ± 0.13", "32.20 ± 4.02", "7.68 ± 1.23", "22.72 ± 0.19"]
    ]
    
    for i, row in enumerate(data):
        for j, val in enumerate(row):
            table.cell(i+1, j).text = val
            table.cell(i+1, j).text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(14)
            
    txbox_bottom = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(6.8), Inches(12.333), Inches(0.5))
    txbox_bottom.text_frame.text = "Performance drops are often within error bars, complicating statistical detection."

    # 4. Higher Temperature Amplifies Performance Gaps but Increases Noise
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
    txbox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(0.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(1))
    tf = txbox.text_frame
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "Higher Temperature Amplifies Performance Gaps but Increases Noise"
    p.font.name = "Arial"
    p.font.size = Pt(32)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x33, 0x66)
    
    try:
        slide.shapes.add_picture("/app/benchmark/assets/figure_1.jpg", Inches(2.5), Inches(1.5), width=Inches(8))
    except Exception as e:
        pass
        
    txbox_bottom = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(6.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(0.8))
    txbox_bottom.text_frame.text = "At temperature 2.0, performance degrades across the board. The gap between original and substitute narrows or becomes noisy, making statistical detection unreliable."

    # 5. Log Probability Fingerprinting Fails Due to Inference Nondeterminism
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
    txbox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(0.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(1))
    tf = txbox.text_frame
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "Log Probability Fingerprinting Fails Due to Inference Nondeterminism"
    p.font.name = "Arial"
    p.font.size = Pt(32)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x33, 0x66)
    
    try:
        slide.shapes.add_picture("/app/benchmark/assets/figure_5.jpg", Inches(2.5), Inches(1.5), width=Inches(8))
    except Exception as e:
        pass
        
    txbox_bottom = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(6.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(0.8))
    txbox_bottom.text_frame.text = "Llama-3-8B produces varying log probabilities across software versions (transformers, vLLM) and hardware (A100, H100). This defeats metadata-based detection."

    # 6. Randomized Routing at Low Rates
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(bullet_layout)
    add_title(slide, "Randomized Routing Makes Detection Query-Prohibitive")
    body = slide.shapes.placeholders[1]
    tf = body.text_frame
    tf.text = "Randomized Substitution Attack:"
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Provider mixes substitute responses with probability p."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Mixed distribution: P_mixed = (1-p) * P_spec + p * P_substitute"
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "As p approaches 0, P_mixed converges to P_spec."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Requires exponentially more queries to detect statistically."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Combined with Benchmark Evasion:"
    p.level = 0
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Providers route known benchmark prompts to genuine models."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Regular traffic is routed to substitute models."
    p.level = 1

    # 7. Software-Only Auditing Methods Are Fundamentally Unreliable
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
    txbox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(0.5), Inches(12.333), Inches(1))
    tf = txbox.text_frame
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = "Software-Only Auditing Methods Are Fundamentally Unreliable"
    p.font.name = "Arial"
    p.font.size = Pt(32)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x33, 0x66)
    
    rows = 4
    cols = 3
    table = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, Inches(0.5), Inches(2), Inches(12.333), Inches(3)).table
    
    headers = ["Method Type", "Weakness", "Practical Limitation"]
    for j, header in enumerate(headers):
        cell = table.cell(0, j)
        cell.text = header
        cell.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
        
    data = [
        ["Text-Based Statistical Tests\n(e.g., MMD)", "Fail against subtle substitutions (e.g., FP8)", "Require impractically large query budgets"],
        ["Log-Probability Fingerprinting", "Defeated by production-level nondeterminism", "False positives from different hardware/software (vLLM, A100 vs H100)"],
        ["Adversarial Countermeasures", "Benchmark evasion & randomized routing (low p)", "Fundamentally query-prohibitive and easily bypassed"]
    ]
    
    for i, row in enumerate(data):
        for j, val in enumerate(row):
            table.cell(i+1, j).text = val
            table.cell(i+1, j).text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(16)

    # 8. Trusted Execution Environments Provide Provable Cryptographic Model Integrity
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(bullet_layout)
    add_title(slide, "Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) Provide Provable Integrity")
    body = slide.shapes.placeholders[1]
    tf = body.text_frame
    tf.text = "Hardware-Secured Enclaves:"
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Cryptographic attestation of the code and data being executed."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Guarantees that specific model weights are loaded."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Provable, Efficient, Robust:"
    p.level = 0
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Modest performance overhead compared to computationally prohibitive ZKPs."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Immune to software-level evasion techniques."
    p.level = 1
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Practical Deployment Path:"
    p.level = 0
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Available today via NVIDIA confidential computing on H100 GPUs."
    p.level = 1

    # 9. Key Takeaways
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(bullet_layout)
    add_title(slide, "Key Takeaways: Close the Verification Gap with Hardware Attestation")
    body = slide.shapes.placeholders[1]
    tf = body.text_frame
    tf.text = "1. Model substitution is economically motivated and practically undetectable via software."
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "2. FP8 quantization barely affects benchmarks, masking substitution."
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "3. Inference nondeterminism kills log-prob fingerprinting."
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "4. Randomized substitution & evasion defeat statistical tests."
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "5. TEEs are the only currently viable path to verifiable LLM APIs."
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = "Call to Action: Transition to hardware attestation for verifiable AI infrastructure."
    p.font.bold = True

    prs.save("/app/output/final_deck.pptx")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    create_deck()
EOF
